terms.gloss: a shallow place where a river can be crossed, a ford; shallows
evidence: Caes. BG 1.6: Rhodanus nōnnūllīs locīs vadō trānsītur (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BC 1.61: vadum in flūmine efficere (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From the root of vādō, go: where one can go through. To ford a river is vadō trānsīre.

phrases.english: in some places the Rhone is crossed by a ford

sources: Lewis & Short: vadum
